title: Harness machine learning for multiple prognoses prediction in sepsis patients: evidence from the MIMIC-IV database.
summary: The open-access primary article builds three ML prognostic models for rapid recovery, chronic critical illness and mortality in 13,174 MIMIC-IV sepsis patients; CatBoost achieves weighted AUC 0.771, with mortality AUC 0.804.
ai_technology: ML models predict three sepsis prognoses from MIMIC-IV clinical features.
organization: Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine, Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China

evidence.tested: The open-access primary article builds three ML prognostic models for rapid recovery, chronic critical illness and mortality in 13,174 MIMIC-IV sepsis patients; CatBoost achieves weighted AUC 0.771, with mortality AUC 0.804.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: ML models predict three sepsis prognoses from MIMIC-IV clinical features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
